title: spec: an object may declare two actions with the same name — Studio creates duplicates and the draft publishes
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced, landing site named.
Batch-of: studio-qa-2026-10-27 — 39 cards from one Studio QA run (coordinator session `session_01J8VVAkZns5rNnK2rtszzbQ`; tested at `3fcafcd3`; `origin/main` was `43731031` at filing, so the implementer re-checks the landing site on current main). The run record is the `qa-run` issue filed with this batch.

## Symptom

Action names are identifiers (they key the action endpoint `/api/v1/actions/<obj>/<name>`), yet duplicates are accepted, so which one runs is undefined.

## Reproduction

1. Studio › Data › Actions › New → three entries ended up named `call_api`.
2. `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/gapdata_supplier?mode=draft&package=…` with two actions named `dup` (labels "Dup A", "Dup B") → 200; publish → live with both.

## Expected

Refused at save (422 naming the duplicate), and Studio derives a unique name.

## Suspected landing site (the implementer verifies)

Object schema action-name uniqueness check in `packages/spec`; Studio action create in `ActionDefaultInspector.tsx` / the actions tab.

## Filing facts

- reach: Studio + metadata save door, measured by the data gap-fill card.
- Business reason: Duplicate identifiers make action execution ambiguous and are a classic AI authoring slip.
- Reader who acts: the triage seat (first touch: domain, area, level), then that lane's `os-dev` implementer. QA suggestion only: `domain:spec`, `area:studio`, p3.
- Dedupe: semantic search `duplicate action names accepted and published on object` on objectstack-ai/objectstack → 8 hits, none about duplicate action names (nearest closed #24472, foreign bound action collision).
- QA id: G10
